upstream_058.reason: Moli fences bare pre elements as well as pre/code, preserving preformatted text. Turndown only recognizes a pre/code pair.

extra_adjacent_code.reason: Adjacent code elements contain ab. Turndown joins their delimiters into one code span whose text contains two extra backticks.

extra_code_nested_format.reason: Code captures raw descendant text. Turndown includes the Markdown markers of nested strong/em elements in the code text.

extra_emphasis_intraword_link.reason: Turndown's star delimiters do not open emphasis at this punctuation boundary. Inline HTML preserves the original emphasized link.

extra_emphasis_intraword_punctuation.reason: CommonMark does not recognize Turndown's intraword delimiters next to punctuation. Inline HTML preserves emphasis without literal stars.

extra_empty_block_inside_inline.reason: Emphasis must close and reopen across paragraph boundaries; delimiters spanning the blank line become literal text.

extra_list_nested_tail.reason: The trailing text belongs to the outer item. Turndown appends it to the nested item, losing the block boundary and joining words.

extra_literal_entities.reason: DOM text is already decoded. Escape literal entity syntax so a Markdown reader does not decode it a second time.

extra_literal_html.reason: Escaped HTML in the source is visible text, not markup. Turndown turns the decoded text into executable Markdown HTML tags.

extra_link_entities.reason: The literal entity syntax in the decoded href must not be decoded again into a different URL.

extra_preformatted_blank.reason: Explicit preformatted-code mode preserves the spaces inside code. Turndown removes a whitespace-only code element entirely.

extra_split_list_marker.reason: Escape list markers across text-node boundaries. Turndown escapes nodes individually and accidentally creates an ordered list.
